description: This file defines an Android activity class 'FinishAffinity' that manages user interactions related to activity nesting and affinity; it includes button click handlers for creating nested instances and finishing affinity groups.

classes.name: FinishAffinity
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates the use of finishAffinity() and activity nesting via button interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and binds button click listeners.

methods.name: mNestListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that starts a new instance of FinishAffinity with an incremented nesting level.

methods.name: mFinishListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that calls finishAffinity() to close all activities in the task.
